Status and short labels. `Chip` default is `color="primary"` (filled blue) and `size="medium"` (32px). In tables use `rp-chip-size-small` (24px).

## Markup
```html
<span class="rp-chip">Default</span>
<span class="rp-chip rp-chip-size-small rp-chip-confirmation">Active</span>
<span class="rp-chip rp-chip-size-small rp-chip-warning">Invitation sent</span>
<span class="rp-chip rp-chip-size-small rp-chip-deactivated">Inactive</span>
<span class="rp-chip rp-chip-size-small rp-chip-brand">New</span>
<span class="rp-chip rp-chip-secondary">Room <button type="button" class="rp-chip-delete" aria-label="Remove Room"><span class="rp-icon rp-icon-close"></span></button></span>
```

## Colors
| Color | Use |
|------|-----|
| `primary` (no class) | Selected or default value (signature "Default") |
| `brand` | "New", "Beta" next to navigation items and links |
| `confirmation` | Active, done, positive |
| `info` | Informative status (Replied) |
| `warning` | Pending, waiting |
| `error` | Failed, negative |
| `deactivated` | Inactive, disabled |
| `secondary` | Neutral tags (departments, keywords), removable filters |

## Rules
- A chip always has text: color alone never carries the status.
- Text in sentence case, 1–2 words.
